events.verdict: Harkless (UTA) and Jokic (DEN) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Bailey (UTA) extends his arm across Jokic's (DEN) upper body as he defends the pick.  This contact occurs prior to any contact initiated by Jokic.
Harkless (UTA) and Jokic (DEN) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Bailey (UTA) initiates contact with Jokic's (DEN) arm prior to making any contact with the ball.
Jokic (DEN) brings his arm toward George's (UTA) path, and the contact is marginal.
Brown (DEN) initiates contact with George's (UTA) arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Brown (DEN) establishes himself in Bailey's (UTA) path prior to the contact.
Bailey (UTA) and Brown (DEN) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Filipowski (UTA) is moving alongside Murray's (DEN) path as he defends the drive.
Braun (DEN) legally contests George's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) briefly grasps Mykhailiuk's (UTA) arm as he secures the rebound.
Jokic (DEN) is retreating alongside George's (UTA) path when they come together at the same spot during the drive.
Murray (DEN) dislodges the ball from George (UTA).

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: George (UTA) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Nuggets.
Brown (DEN) establishes himself in Bailey's (UTA) path prior to the contact.
Filipowski (UTA) grabs and pulls Jokic's (DEN) jersey away from his body off-ball.
Harkless (UTA) makes contact with Murray's (DEN) arm that affects his jump shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) engages and dislodges Filipowski (UTA) during the free throw attempt and falls on top of him.
Utah is assessed a delay of game violation for not promptly lining up for the free throw.

Replay review of the foul called on Jokic (DEN) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful.  Jokic legally defends George's (UTA) driving shot attempt, applying a legal forearm to George's side during the drive and then dislodging the ball with contact to the ball (and his hand that is in contact with the ball) before making incidental contact to George's arm.
Harkless (UTA) commits a take foul on Jokic (DEN).  The contact occurs prior to the start of Jokic's upward shooting motion, and a non-shooting foul is correctly called.
Brown (DEN) legally contests George's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) deflects the ball away from Sensabaugh (UTA) as they pursue the rebound.
Filipowski (UTA) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Nuggets.
